prepared.title: A recurring whole marks prohibition rather than descriptive action
A recurring whole marks temporal precedence without causing the next state
A recurring whole distributes a predicate over members rather than forming one collective

screening: Three unappended drafts were logically corrected: prohibition is a narrow specialization of IDEA000028; temporal precedence permits downstream correlation; distributive scope does not require heterogeneous outcomes. Exact primary spans and hashes validate. They remain raw and underdetermined; binding availability is explicitly unknown.

countermodels.prohibition: A register/template wrapper can mimic negative status; IDEA000028 already covers forbidden modality broadly.
countermodels.temporal: Temporal order can correlate with downstream consequences without being causal; wrapper or position can mimic order.
countermodels.distributive: Uniform member outcomes can still be distributive; repeated fields can be renderer output for a collective group.
